title: One line of <data>/diagrams.ndjson (the diagram side log), also one entry of GET /api/v1/diagram/:task/history
description: Append-only, fsynced before the response, torn last line cut on start (as the journal). The in-memory projection (pointers, proposals, request index, retired ids, used evidence, comment anchors, pointer-message blocks, coordinator removal counters) is rebuilt from this file on start, never from state.json, so a state.json rebuilt by an older release loses nothing of it. Lines with a rev point at a blob media/<sha256> written (temp then rename) before the line. A line is the audit record of a diagram write: who, when, what ops, why, on what evidence. History returns these lines newest first without ops unless ?ops=1. Rev 2: every line names its diagram_id (dg-<n of its create line>), so a re-created task id never mixes with an archived diagram (M2). op feedback.anchor (M3) is written by the board after a journaled feedback.add with node_id: it is the only source of a comment's anchor. op diagram.archive (M2) detaches the diagram from its task. journal_seq is the journal seq at the write, the clock every evidence order check uses.

id.description: Side-log sequence, monotonic across all tasks.

diagram_id.description: dg-<n> where dw-<n> is the diagram's create line.

task_created_at.description: On create lines: the task row's attribution.created_at. The diagram is attached only while the live task row has this same created_at; a task deleted and re-created (including on an older release during a rollback) leaves the diagram detached.

actor_ui.description: Owner lines only: which owner UI credential made the write (contract 3.5). An owner line without it never exists.

journal_seq.description: state.seq when this line was written (same synchronous section).

rev.description: Set when the line made a revision.

pinned.description: Pin state after this line (set on pin lines and on the first owner apply). Only owner lines carry it.

removed_ids.description: Node, edge and region ids this revision removed: they join the retired set of this diagram_id.

removed_nodes.description: Count of node ids in removed_ids (the removal window, contract 3.4).

answer_owner_device.description: Coordinator decide lines: the owner device the bound ask was answered from (class B clause 9). Such a line clears the removal window, as an owner-device line does.

changed_ids.description: Node ids whose content changed (added, text or fields); layout moves are not listed.

node_id.description: feedback.anchor lines: the node it is anchored on (present in the revision current at the comment).

anchor_rev.description: feedback.anchor lines: the rev current when the comment was written.
